notes: JIT speed fix: on iOS 26+ the app's own memory faults no longer go through Benstore's debugger, which made emulators crawl. The JIT log also shows whether the app asked for JIT memory.

versions.notes: JIT speed fix: on iOS 26+ the app's own memory faults no longer go through Benstore's debugger, which made emulators crawl. The JIT log also shows whether the app asked for JIT memory.
JIT: Settings → JIT → Enable JIT opens a sideloaded app with JIT on (emulators and similar). Works on iOS 17+, including the iOS 26+ method on newer iPhones. Needs LocalDevVPN and Developer Mode.

Remote install from a file: in a phone's screen in the Admin Panel, tap Choose IPA File to install an IPA from your iPhone. It's uploaded to a temporary host and the phone downloads and verifies it. Pasting an https link still works.

Admin Panel now remembers every phone for good: once Benstore is opened on a phone, it stays on your list (showing when it was last seen) instead of dropping off after a day. Swipe a phone to forget it.
Admin Panel is now inside Benstore, only on the iPhone that holds your admin key (Settings → Remote installs). The web panel is gone.

New admin panel: every phone with Benstore shows up with its model, iOS version and Benstore version, and you can install an app on any of them. While Benstore is open it now checks for requests every 15 seconds.
Remote installs now has an off switch (Settings → Remote installs). It's on by default. Off means this iPhone stops showing up in your admin panel and ignores every request.

Remote install + admin panel. Your admin panel (admin.html) can install an app onto this iPhone; Benstore checks the request is from your key and asks you three times before installing. Turn the prompts off in Settings -> Remote installs -> Allow remote downloads.
Your theme's app icon comes back on its own: after returning from an older version, Benstore puts the themed icon back when it opens.
The Return to current version button in older versions (1.0 to 1.36) now follows your theme color. Reinstall an older version from the list to get it.
Themes: Settings → Appearance → Theme. Orange, Classic Purple (the 1.0 color), Blue, Green, Pink, Red and Teal, each with a matching app icon. Reopen Benstore after picking one.
Install Older Version now covers 1.0 to 1.61. Versions 1.0 to 1.36 come with an orange Return to current version button on every screen, and the list shows which ones have it.

Experimental: Settings → Experimental → Install Older Version lists every Benstore build and installs the one you pick. The current version is always at the top so you can come back. Apps, Apple ID and settings stay.
Refresh applies App Groups: refreshing an app re-signs it fully when its signature is missing its groups, so you don't need to delete and reinstall.
App Groups fix for free Apple IDs: turn on App Groups the way AltStore does (only that feature), with a fallback to Apple's newer API.
Fix: App Groups and Auto-strip now find the app's files (1.55-1.57 looked in the wrong folder, so neither kicked in). The log now says exactly what happened with App Groups.

Register App Groups: apps that use App Groups (like Erosion) get real groups under your team ID, group.<name>.<team ID>, the same way AltStore does it, including on backup Apple IDs. Toggle it in Settings → Installing (on by default). If Apple refuses a group, the install still finishes and Sideload Fixes covers it.
Auto-strip switch: turn auto-strip on or off in Settings → Installing (on by default).

Auto-strip: if an app won't install because of something inside it (a broken extension, Watch app, App Clip, junk files, device-only limits), Benstore strips the parts it's choking on and retries automatically. Frameworks the app needs and your tweaks are never removed. Each step shows in the log.
